title: USAspending Award DEMS0000003: Talon Nickel Project Double Play
publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, USAspending
summary: The captured USAspending API record identifies Talon Nickel (USA) LLC, award DEMS0000003, a $114.85 million federal obligation, $954,321.45 in reported outlays, $250.88 million in non-federal funding, and an October 31, 2026 current end date for Project Double Play.
key_findings: The award is a named DOE project grant for an advanced domestic battery-minerals processing facility.
The captured record reports $114,846,344 obligated and $954,321.45 outlayed.
The record reports $250,881,777 in non-federal funding and a performance period from November 1, 2023 through October 31, 2026.
why_it_matters: This is the collection's clearest obligation-and-outlay trail and repairs an existing FTFN signal by preserving the source response used for the amounts.
ftfn_relevance: Separates funding administration from facility construction and operating evidence.
Creates a reusable award-level anchor for later transaction and project-milestone checks.
evidence_limits: Obligations and outlays do not prove permitting, construction, equipment installation, commissioning, feedstock, qualification, offtake, or production.
USAspending values can change with later transactions and reporting updates.
